```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(oce)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

load("data/uvp6_associated_ctd_20260202.RData")

# Amundsen metadata
load("data/UVP6_Calanus_metadata_20260129.RData")

colnames(ctd)

# Add region info
region_rename <- data.frame(
  region = c("Baffin Bay", "Baffin Shelf", 
             "Davis Strait", "Lancaster Sound",
             "North Water Polynya", "Labrador Shelf", 
              "Nares Strait"),
  region.inuktitut = c("Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
                       "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
                       "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
                       "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
                       "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
                       "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)",
                       "Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)"),
  region.color = c("goldenrod2","purple2","turquoise2","forestgreen",
                   "deeppink1","blue1", "sienna2")) %>% 
  # order regions as factors by latitude
  mutate(region.inuktitut = factor(
    region.inuktitut,
    levels = c("Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)",
               "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
               "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
               "Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
               "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)"
    ))) %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut)

ctd <- ctd %>% 
  filter(!is.na(te90)) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(uvp6_ctd_match, ctd_filename, region),
            by = join_by(filename == ctd_filename)) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename, 
            by = "region") 

```

# Calculate average temperature at 100 m depth intervals 
```{r}
temp_profiles_100m <- ctd %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = floor(pressure/100)*100)  %>% 
  # # for upper 100 m, do 0-20, 20-60, 60-100
  # mutate(depth_bin = if_else(pressure < 20, 0+10, depth_bin),
  #        depth_bin = if_else(pressure >= 20 & pressure < 60, 40, depth_bin),
  #        depth_bin = if_else(pressure >= 60 & pressure < 100, 80, depth_bin)) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cruise_name, station, datetime, latitude, longitude,
           region, region.inuktitut, region.color, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(temp.mean = mean(te90, na.rm = T),
            temp.sd = sd(te90, na.rm = T),
            ndepths = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(temp_profiles_100m, 
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = temp.mean, group = filename)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = region.inuktitut), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~cruise_name, scales = "free_y")


# Get average temperature per 100m bin for each region
region_temp_profiles_100m <- temp_profiles_100m %>% 
  group_by(region, region.inuktitut, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(reg.temp.mean = mean(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            reg.temp.sd = sd(temp.mean, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(region_temp_profiles_100m, 
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = reg.temp.mean, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = reg.temp.mean-reg.temp.sd,
                    ymax = reg.temp.mean+reg.temp.sd),
                alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = c(0, 50, seq(100,3000,100)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.8, 0.3)) +
  ylab("Temperature") + xlab("Depth")
# 
# ggsave("figures/Supp_region_ave_temp_100m.png",
#        width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# Calculate MLD
```{r}
mld.df <- ctd %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sigt)) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cast_number, station, region, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  # Get MLD as 0.003 threshold
  arrange(depth) %>% 
  mutate(sigt_diff = diff(sigt)) %>% 
  ungroup()


sigt_profiles_100m <- mld.df %>% 
  mutate(depth_bin = floor(pressure/100)*100) %>% 
  group_by(filename, cruise_name, station, datetime, latitude, longitude,
           region, region.inuktitut, region.color, depth_bin) %>% 
  summarise(sigt.mean = mean(sigt, na.rm = T),
            sigt.sd = sd(sigt, na.rm = T),
            ndepths = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(sigt_profiles_100m, 
       aes(x = depth_bin, y = sigt.mean, group = filename)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = region.inuktitut), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~cruise_name, scales = "free_y")

```


# Export the temperature data in 100 m bins
```{r, eval=FALSE}
save(temp_profiles_100m, region_temp_profiles_100m, region_rename,
     uvp6_ctd_match,
     file = "data/ctd_temperature_100m_averages_20260202.RData")
```


# T-S plots of each region
```{r}
library(oce)
AA <- ctd
AA <- mld.df %>% 
  filter(filename == "AS_CTD_2023_02_033.csv.nc")

df.oce <- oce::as.ctd(salinity = AA$psal,
                      temperature = AA$te90,
                      pressure = AA$pressure,
                      time = AA$datetime,
                      ship = AA$platform_name,
                      cruise = AA$cruise_name,
                      station = AA$station,
                      longitude = AA$longitude,
                      latitude = AA$latitude)

plot(df.oce)
oce::plotTS(df.oce)

# # Calculate Mixed layer depth
# df.oce <- oce::oceSetMetadata(df.oce, "MLD", 3)
# df.oce[["MLD"]]


calculate_mld <- function(pressure, density, reference_depth = 10, threshold = 0.03) {
  # # ctd_profile <- arrange(ctd_profile, pressure)
  # pressure <- ctd_profile$pressure
  # density <- ctd_profile$sigt
  
  ii <- sort(pressure, index.return = T)
  pressure <- pressure[ii$ix]
  density <- density[ii$ix]
  
  # Find index of reference depth
  ref_index <- max(which(pressure <= reference_depth))
  if (length(ref_index) < 1) {
    stop("No data near surface reference depth.")
  }
  
  ref_density <- mean(density[ref_index])
  mld_criterion <- ref_density + threshold

  # Find density above threshold
  mld_index <- which(density >= mld_criterion)[1]

    
  if (!is.na(mld_index)) {
    return(pressure[mld_index])
  } else {
    # If no depth meets the criterion (e.g., fully mixed water column)
    return(max(pressure, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

ctd_mld <- ctd %>% 
  group_by(filename) %>% 
  mutate(MLD = calculate_mld(pressure, sigt)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(pressure == MLD)

ggplot(ctd_mld, aes(x = sigt, y = MLD,
                    color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color))


ggplot(ctd_mld, aes(x = sigt, y = MLD,
                    color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,50))
```
